customer_text: app keeps crashing every time i open it tried reinstalling twice still broken
brand_reply: Hey sorry about that! Try: 1) Log out & back in 2) Clear app cache in Settings 3) Reinstall from the App Store. Let us know! ^SP

customer_text: songs keep skipping and pausing randomly on android phone so frustrating
brand_reply: Ugh that's annoying! Make sure your Android battery optimization isn't restricting Spotify. Settings > Apps > Spotify > Battery > No Restrictions. ^SP

customer_text: offline downloads disappeared after the update all my songs are gone
brand_reply: Oh no! Go to Your Library > Downloads and re-sync. Make sure you're on WiFi and have enough storage. Still missing? DM us! ^SP

customer_text: bluetooth keeps disconnecting from car speakers every new song
brand_reply: Try: 1) Forget Spotify device in car settings 2) Re-pair 3) Disable battery saver for Spotify on your phone. Does that help? ^SP

customer_text: spotify connect not working cant see my speaker in the app
brand_reply: Make sure your phone and speaker are on the same WiFi network. Then open Spotify > tap the speaker icon at the bottom. Still not showing? ^SP

customer_text: premium plan showing as free even though i just paid
brand_reply: Hi! Can you check your account at spotify.com/account? If it still shows Free after 24hrs please DM us your account email! ^SP

customer_text: student discount verification keeps failing im definitely enrolled
brand_reply: Sorry about that! Try verifying in an incognito browser window at spotify.com/student. Still failing? DM us your school name and we'll look into it! ^SP

customer_text: family plan invite link says its expired
brand_reply: Invite links expire after 24 hours! Go to spotify.com/family > Manage Plan > Resend the invite. Also check you haven't hit the 6-person limit! ^SP

customer_text: how do i transfer playlists from apple music to spotify
brand_reply: Great news — you can use a free tool called Soundiiz at soundiiz.com to transfer your playlists. Takes about 5 mins! ^SP

customer_text: how do i enable crossfade between songs cant find setting
brand_reply: Easy one! Go to Settings > Playback > Crossfade and drag the slider. You can set it from 1 to 12 seconds ^SP

customer_text: why is this album completely greyed out cant play any of it
brand_reply: Some albums aren't available in all regions due to licensing. Check if your account country matches your actual location at spotify.com/account ^SP

customer_text: explicit filter is off but songs are still greyed out on my playlist
brand_reply: Hmm! Try toggling the explicit content filter off AND back on in Settings. If specific tracks are still grey let us know which ones! ^SP

customer_text: podcast episodes wont download offline i have premium and space
brand_reply: Try removing the podcast from your library and re-adding it. Then download on WiFi. Also check Settings > Data Saver is off. ^SP

customer_text: lyrics are way out of sync like 5 seconds behind the music
brand_reply: Known quirk! Close the lyrics view and reopen it. If it's a specific song please report it via the 3-dot menu > Report. ^SP

customer_text: songs i added to playlist yesterday disappeared today
brand_reply: Odd! Check if your playlist is set to Collaborative — others can edit those. Tap the 3 dots > Collaborative Playlist to check. ^SP

customer_text: spotify on mac freezes when i try to play local files
brand_reply: For local files on Mac: 1) Toggle Settings > Local Files off then on 2) Try the website installer instead of App Store version. Better? ^SP

customer_text: cant play music on my echo device after latest update
brand_reply: Try relinking: Alexa app > Skills & Games > Spotify > Disable > Re-enable. Make sure both apps are fully updated! ^SP

customer_text: app stuttering and buffering on 4g fine on wifi
brand_reply: This is usually a data speed issue. Try turning off Data Saver in Settings > Data Saver. Also make sure Download Quality isn't set too high. ^SP

customer_text: how do i set up equalizer on spotify
brand_reply: Great question! Head to Settings > Playback > Equalizer. You can choose presets or create your own. ^SP

customer_text: how do i make a collaborative playlist with my friends
brand_reply: Tap the 3 dots on any playlist you made > Collaborative Playlist. Share the link and friends can add songs! ^SP

customer_text: new desktop redesign is awful please bring back old layout
brand_reply: We hear you! We know big changes are tough. Please share your detailed thoughts at community.spotify.com — our product team reads everything! ^SP

customer_text: please add hi fi audio quality to spotify been waiting forever
brand_reply: Ha we feel the excitement! We can't share specifics but your voice matters. Drop your idea at community.spotify.com! ^SP

customer_text: want to cancel premium but cant find where in the app
brand_reply: Cancellation is done on the web! Visit spotify.com/account > Your Plan > Cancel Premium. It stays active until your billing period ends. ^SP

customer_text: how do i use spotify on my tv
brand_reply: You can use Spotify on smart TVs via the built-in app or cast from your phone using Spotify Connect. Search 'Spotify' in your TV's app store! ^SP

customer_text: app using way too much battery on iphone
brand_reply: Tip: disable Automix in Settings > Playback and set streaming quality to Normal when on mobile data. This cuts battery use significantly! ^SP

customer_text: how do i see my listening history
brand_reply: Tap the clock icon at the top right of Home to see your recent listening history! ^SP

customer_text: songs in my daily mix keep repeating same ones every day
brand_reply: Your Daily Mix learns from what you play most! Try liking more variety or exploring different playlists to help it diversify. ^SP

customer_text: cant log into my account password reset email never arrives
brand_reply: Check your spam folder! Also try resetting at spotify.com/password-reset using a different email client. Still nothing? DM us! ^SP

customer_text: app shows wrong account name after i updated it
brand_reply: Log out and back in to refresh your profile. If it still shows the old name DM us your account email and we'll take a look! ^SP

customer_text: how do i share a specific song with a friend
brand_reply: Easy! Tap the 3 dots next to any track > Share. You can share a link via WhatsApp Instagram or copy the link directly. ^SP
